content: <thought>The mass spectrum indicates C₁₂H₁₅Cl. The ¹H NMR shows a para‑disubstituted aromatic ring (two doublets, 2 H each) and an aliphatic region with a 10 H multiplet at ~1.35 ppm (five CH₂ groups) and a single CH at ~2.63 ppm (benzylic CH attached to the aromatic ring). This fits a cyclohexane ring (C₆H₁₁) bearing a para‑chlorophenyl substituent. The structure 1‑(4‑chlorophenyl)cyclohexane has the formula C₁₂H₁₅Cl and matches all spectral features. Its SMILES notation is “Clc1ccc(cc1)C2CCCCC2”. This SMILES is valid and corresponds to the observed data.>
